name: Case 2 · Red Light
blurb: The Stacks, night. Every light on Dayo Sanni's street turned green at once. Then he vanished.

lines.text: Traffic gridlock. Every light on the junction flips green at once. Metal crunches into metal. Horns blare. Total chaos.
"Traffic control says the command originated locally. Dayo Sanni's terminal. Whoever grabbed him made him log in first."

scenes.title: Where did they take him, and how?

scenes.win_text: Needle slips between two satellite dishes, panting. But Dayo is already gone—loaded into the convoy idling below.

scenes.brief: [SIGHTLINE UPLINK] The convoy splits three ways out of the Stacks. The algorithm is highlighting the most probable route. Trust the math.

scenes.win_text: The lead bike slides out. The rider is a middle-aged civilian, shaking, bleeding. A Spool in his jacket holds his family's address and his debts.

scenes.prompt: The driver was coerced. He has a wife, two kids, and a number he has to call in ten minutes.

left.label: Flip him as an informant
left.result: You slip the burner back into his pocket. "You work for us now." He nods, terrified.
left.echo: An informant inside the Kites. It opens Case 3 from the dispatch side.

right.label: Book him
right.result: Cuffs click. By the book. Patch approves; the man's family weeping in the precinct lobby does not.
right.echo: Clean record, closed door. Case 3 starts colder.

hesitate.label: You hesitated
hesitate.result: The squad takes him into custody while you stare at his phone. Processing takes the decision out of your hands.
hesitate.echo: The squad noticed you froze on a person, not a problem.

scenes.title: They are not asking for ransom
scenes.text: The driver stares at the interrogation table. "There is no ransom. They are not asking for money. They are making them BUILD something."
scenes.cliff: [RADIO STATIC] Dispatch? We got a problem. A third red kite just dropped on a dispatcher's desk at Portside.
